description: This Java class `PolicyModelJsonExamplesProducer` generates example JSON files representing authorization context and policy models for testing or demonstration purposes. It creates directories, constructs policy and authorization objects, and serializes them to JSON files.

classes.name: PolicyModelJsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class for generating sample JSON policy and authorization data for testing purposes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that takes a directory path argument and initiates JSON generation.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Creates authorization context JSON files in the specified root directory.

methods.name: producePolicyModel
methods.description: Generates policy model JSON files within the project directory structure.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a Jsonifiable object to a JSON string and writes it to a file.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes a JSON string to a specified file path.
